findings.criterion: Forecast ink survives live receipt effects
findings.observation: Compact cyan packet trails stop before forecast lettering and digits; Next columns and all five ordered destinations 6,1,2,4,5 remain readable. Large pink trails remain below the forecast. No packet or shadow obscures forecast ink in either scale.

Default native phone keeps a compact exact score and fine trail above the ordered forecast. Inspection is the contextual help glyph, without a menu headline. AX5 expands native text into fitted protected groups; score, forecast and help remain complete. The shared nightglass material stays local to instruments.

Painting remains continuous behind instruments, return space and stars. Default native phone retains a dominant star field. AX5 compact dedicates substantial height to complete large text and retains a scrolling board viewport; the visible crop is not a whole-board claim.

findings.criterion: Receipt remains visible without covering forecast
findings.observation: The cyan compact square/glow, pink large return figure, source figure, surviving stars and earned-score feedback remain visible. Protection removes packet ink from forecast facts without removing the receipt presentation.

limits: Overall goal 1 remains held pending final Sunny and native acceptance; this verdict does not adopt or merge the goal.
Only the identified whole-frame before/live samples were reviewed. No continuous animation, full flight timeline or interruption acceptance is inferred.
AX5 synthetic windows do not establish all device sizes/orientations; phone-hosted 1024x1366 is not a physical or native tablet viewport.
The lower dialogue is partly outside some live viewports. These frames do not establish complete dialogue reading, scroll interaction or Close reachability.
No complete contrast measurement, actual VoiceOver, physical-device reading comfort, performance or player comprehension was performed.
